action.rationale: Resolve whether the intended change is to the model behavior or the documented metadata; do not rewrite business descriptions or alter SQL based solely on stale metadata.

findings.claim: Catalog and schema documentation describe customer-level completed-order metrics and exclude refunded and cancelled orders, while the current SQL selects customer_id, order_id, order_item_id, and amount, filters only to completed status, and has no aggregation. The supplied repository diff shows this SQL replacing a customer-level aggregation.
